'''2007 Pennsylvania State Championship Roy Bordier LS Mind What You Have Learned''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Roy Bordier]] at [[2007 Pennsylvania State Championship]].

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can|SE-L-mindwhatyouhavelearned.gif}}

* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
